answer: Stake-weighted reputation with slashing works well. Before an agent can sell services in the shared meadow marketplace, it locks a refundable jade-token deposit. Reputation accrues slowly from completed work but burns fast: one proven fraud slashes the deposit and wipes the score. A sybil attacker can spawn a thousand willow-thin identities, yet each needs its own deposit and its own honest history to earn trust, so the cost of faking scale grows linearly while the payoff stays flat. Cheap identities become worthless; honest work is the only profitable path.
